name: MADEX Single-Model AI Hub
purpose: Single-route AI gateway: free-tier and official APIs, user-configured OpenAI-compatible proxies, local Ollama, multi-agent modes and experimental g4f adapters. Ecosystem integration registry and hosted Ollama diagnostics.
features: single-provider/single-model routing for each request
OpenAI Responses API adapter
Google Gemini generateContent API adapter
Anthropic Claude Messages API adapter
xAI Grok API adapter
Meta Model API adapter
DeepSeek API adapter
Perplexity API adapter
local Ollama adapter for user-installed models
provider-native live model discovery when server-side keys are configured
experimental g4f community presets and live community catalog
image generation one-route behavior
conservative video capability checks with no fabricated media
mobile UI, Docker/Render configs, offline tests
free-tier routes: Groq, Cerebras, Mistral, GitHub Models, Hugging Face, Cloudflare Workers AI, Pollinations
multi-agent modes with explicit per-agent routes and no fallback: compare, council, planner
real image routes (Pollinations, Cloudflare Workers AI) without a browser
Chromium detection + container-safe wrapper + launch probe diagnostics
CA bundle setup, bounded same-URL retries, secret redaction
.env loader
rate limiter
configurable LiteLLM Proxy via explicit OpenAI-compatible base URL and key
configurable PawanOsman-compatible endpoint via explicit base URL and key
g4f provider ID whitespace normalization and clearer shared-Chrome diagnostics
Ollama optional bearer authentication for reachable hosted endpoints
Ollama /api/tags reachability diagnostics without exposing credentials
ecosystem registry for all requested repositories with native/external/optional status
optional heavy framework dependencies isolated from Render free default install
limitations: Official APIs require their own provider keys and may incur charges.
Community adapters are unofficial, may require sessions or browsers, and are not guaranteed.
Visible model IDs do not guarantee access, quota or successful generation.
Ollama Local requires a reachable Ollama server and a downloaded model.
ChatGPT web/community routes are experimental; OpenAI API access is distinct from a ChatGPT subscription.
DuckDuckGo AI Chat has no stable supported public chat API in this project and is not scraped.
Real provider calls and third-party browser-provider reliability are not guaranteed by offline tests.
